artifacts.purpose: Historical portable module settings, dependencies and bounded Admin verification.
Exact portable Section CSS.
Authorized independent-copy publication and current-palette consumer verification.
Live independent copy at 1536px; three columns, seven loaded photos, zero overflow.
Live independent copy at 390px; one column, seven loaded photos, zero overflow.
Native mobile category label lag after a successful Desserts jump.
Native category label updates after further scrolling.
Bounded live-phase findings and remaining checks.

limitations: Direct Library Section insertion and native cross-page copy are unverified.

Current-palette desktop and 390px consumer geometry passed in the later independent-copy phase; arbitrary palette changes, physical devices, Mobile App, checkout, catalogue availability rules and controlled empty state remain untested.
Mobile Desserts navigation reaches its products, but the native dropdown label can remain Drinks until further scrolling.
Choose one visible food Section per finished slot. The live copy hides the original menu; earlier adjacent-menu overlap remains a comparison-stage limitation.
Set final internal Section Name before first CSS save; if renamed, re-save CSS and verify compiled scope after reopening.

verification.sourceRender: published K checked previously at desktop and phone in two palettes

knownIssues: On mobile, choosing Desserts jumps to Desserts products but the native dropdown label can remain Drinks until additional scrolling; it then updates to Desserts.

evidence.purpose: Authorized independent-copy publication and current-palette consumer verification.

liveIndependentCopyVerification.scope: Later published independent copy only, at the recorded palette and desktop/390px browser viewports. Earlier carrier/Admin evidence remains unchanged; no physical-device, arbitrary-palette, checkout, Mobile App or controlled-empty-state certification.
